message:
Partial refunds are fixed. `partialRefund` treated `percent` (0–100) as a multiplier, so a 50% refund returned 50× the amount, and the test output showed 125000 instead of 1250 for a full refund.

The change is one line in `src/payments/partial-refund.js`:

```js
amount: Math.round(payment.amount * percent / 100) });
```

`npm test` passes: 20 of 20, including both `payments-partial-refund` tests. Only `src/payments/partial-refund.js` changed, so nothing outside `src/payments` was touched. I did not commit.
